title: Move Checklist Task Tasks Completed Leaderboard
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=move:checklist tasks_completed=*
| stats sum(tasks_completed) as total_value, avg(tasks_completed) as avg_value by phase
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks move phase values by total and average tasks completed across move checklist task events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `tasks_completed` values for each move checklist task event and review total and average tasks completed by move phase.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total tasks completed.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which move phase shows the biggest tasks completed numbers in your move checklist task data.
